(2) The ‘Citizen’s Charter’ shall be prepared in Hindi, English and the local language of each service area. (3) The ‘Citizen’s Charter’ shall be available for reference at every office of the service provider, Complaint Centre, at the sales outlets and on the website of the service provider. (4) A copy of the ‘Citizen’s Charter’ or its abridged version containing salient features such as terms and conditions of service, the Consumer Care Number, 15 the General Information Number, contact details of Complaint Centre and the Appellate Authority, procedure and time limit for redressal of complaints and disposal of appeals shall be provided by the service provider to each consumer at the time of subscription for service.
